nodes.name: Remotive Due? (3x/day)
nodes.notes: Remotive allows max 4 calls/day, so it is only fetched at 8 AM, 4 PM and 8 PM.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO radar_leads (source, external_id, title, company, url, location, budget, description, posted_at)
SELECT source, external_id, title, company, url, location, budget, description, posted_at
FROM json_populate_recordset(NULL::radar_leads, $1::json)
ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, source, title, company, url, location, budget, description;

parameters.jsCode:

return $input.all().filter(i => i.json.id);

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-oss-120b', temperature: 0.2, reasoning_effort: 'low', max_completion_tokens: 700, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You screen freelance and remote job posts for Adnan, a solo full-stack developer in Lahore, Pakistan (brand: Infinity AI). His skills: website development and web apps (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Supabase or Postgres), API development and third-party integrations, e-commerce websites and Shopify stores, payment gateway integration, WhatsApp bots and WhatsApp Business API automation, AI chatbots and AI agents (OpenAI or Groq LLMs, RAG), voice AI, and n8n, Make or Zapier workflow automation. Proof of work: haps.pk (healthcare client) and Nexus Ops, an open-source n8n AI lead pipeline. Score 80-100 = strong fit: matches his skills, open to remote workers in Pakistan or worldwide, contract or project work, realistic for one person. Score 50-79 = partial fit. Score 0-49 = poor fit: mostly unrelated skills, onsite, restricted to US or EU residents only, needs citizenship or clearance, unpaid or equity only, very senior full-time role in an unrelated stack, or looks like spam. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no markdown: {"score": <integer 0-100>, "fit": "strong|partial|poor", "reason": "<one short sentence>", "suggested_pitch": "<two-sentence opening line Adnan could send, mentioning relevant proof>"}" }, { role: 'user', content: 'Source: ' + $json.source + '
Title: ' + $json.title + '
Company: ' + ($json.company || 'n/a') + '
Location: ' + ($json.location || 'n/a') + '
Budget: ' + ($json.budget || 'n/a') + '
Description: ' + ($json.description || '') } ] }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE radar_leads
SET score = $1, fit = $2, reason = $3, suggested_pitch = $4, status = 'scored'
WHERE id = $5
RETURNING id;
